# Doctor Demographics

> Since 1983, Doctor Demographics has provided demographic and psychographic data and custom reports that help doctors and practice owners (dental, medical, optometry, veterinary) choose the perfect place to put a practice.

Doctor Demographics, LLC. Founder: Scott McDonald (now retired). Owner and Lead Demographer: Mike Green. Phone: (844) 704-0499. Email: support@doctordemographics.com.

## Reports and services

* [All demographic reports](https://doctordemographics.com/reports/): overview of every report.
* [Best Sites Report](https://doctordemographics.com/best-sites-report/): Report and consultation. Finds the 5 best sites in an area you define (up to 5 counties in the same state), with a 20 minute consultation. Price: $795.
* [Site Viability Report](https://doctordemographics.com/site-viability-report/): Checks the viability of one practice location before you sign, using 14 contiguous zip codes and drive time radii, with a 20 minute consultation. Price: $495 (discount for multiple sites).
* [Marketing Report](https://doctordemographics.com/marketing-report/): Research based analysis of a practice brand, marketing tools, competition and clinical offerings. Price: $695.
* [Competition Report](https://doctordemographics.com/comp-report/): Analysis of the local competition for a professional practice. Price: $350 per site.
* [Telephone Consultation](https://doctordemographics.com/telephone-consultation/): Live telephone consultation on practice placement, marketing and other challenges. Price: $149.
